records.title: DMPV3 repo-owned nvda extension leaves preserve canonical semantic-dependency truth
records.observed_behaviour_from_read_evidence: DMPV3 packet construction now preserves caller-supplied custom extension leaves while restoring repo-owned nvda.schema_identifiers and nvda.semantic_dependencies after extension merge. Semantic dependency annotations therefore remain tied to canonical lineage dependency IDs rather than caller-supplied injected values.
records.test_first_gap_or_action: A new Tier A DMPV3 extension canonical-leaf family was written before source repair. The pre-repair run failed because custom dmpextensions.nvda.semantic_dependencies could replace canonical dependency lineage. The bounded repair restores canonical semantic_dependencies after custom extension merge while preserving unrelated custom extension leaves.
adjudication_notes: ACABC-0016 is a new-test-family DMPV3 row with donor records marked missing or same-surface evidence only. This record does not import those donor domain classes; it hardens the native packet-carriage seam so missing donor semantics cannot be smuggled through caller-supplied nvda extension leaves.
The generated all-surface active-code Atlas was used only as navigation and not as semantic proof.
limitations: This pass does not implement donor TemporalStateFeaturePayload, ParallelRiskTemporalSurface, RuntimeStateVector, financial-calendar, coefficient, cognition, or carry-market service classes.
This pass does not open runtime trading, financial/risk policy, broker/API execution, dependency, vocabulary, original Atlas/Bridge JSON, generated slice, or refactor work.
